history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration continue to work through the joint coordination committee and the Advisory Board of the United Nations Fund for International Partnerships to urge the United Nations Foundation to contribute more resources directly to the United Nations in support of the Organization’s activities.
history.administration_response: In 2021, the United Nations Foundation provided the United Nations Fund for International Partnerships (UNFIP) (administered by the United Nations Office for Partnerships) grants worth approximately $11.9 million for projects implemented by United Nations partners. As at 31 December 2022, the United Nations Foundation had provided $27.3 million in grants to the United Nations system through UNFIP – an increase of approximately 250 per cent in contributions from the United Nations Foundation to the United Nations from 2021. Accordingly, the United Nations Office for Partnerships requests that this recommendation be closed.
history.board_assessment: Given that the contributions by the United Nations Foundation to the United Nations still need relatively long-term observation, the Board considers this recommendation to be under implementation.
